column1: 爾時如來為末世薄福一切眾生故， 說真言教法。
column2: At that time, on behalf of all the unfortunate beings of the final age of the Dharma, the Tathāgata expounded the mantra-teaching.

column1: 時一切日月星宿皆悉雲集， 前後圍繞， 異口同音白言： 「唯願如來而為我等說於神呪。 」于時世尊說八星呪曰：
column2: At that time, the sun, moon, stars, and lunar lodges surrounded the Buddha and assembled like clouds all around him, and in unison uttered this question: ‘Would the Tathāgata expound for us the spirit-spell?’ At that time, the World-Honored One uttered the eight-star spell: Om sapta-jināya bhajāmi jyāya jambū-dhāma svāmi-nakṣatram bhavatu svāhā.

column1: 「(oṃ)(sa)(pta)(ji)(na)(ya)(bha)(ñja)(vi)(ja)(ya)唵颯跢而曩野伴惹密惹野(jaṃ)(pū)(tha)(ma)(sva)(mi)(na)(ra)(kṣaṃ)染普他摩娑嚩(二合)弭曩囉乞山(二合)(bha)(va)(tu)(svā)(hā)婆嚩都莎呵」其印明出《金剛頂經．七星品》。
column2: This mudrā and mantra come from the Seven Star section of the Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha [Note: this section does not exist!].

column1: 佛告貪狼、破軍等言： 「若有善男子善女人受持是神呪， 擁護否？ 」于時八女白世尊言： 「若有人每日誦此神呪，
column2: The Buddha told Hungry Wolf, Ruiner of Armies, and the others: ‘If there are good sons and daughters who receive and maintain this spirit-spell and preserve it, will you protect them or not?’ At that time, the Eight Ladies answered the World-Honored One: ‘If someone chants this spirit-spell every day, their evil karma will certainly be completely eradicated, and they will accomplish everything they wish.

column1: 決定罪業皆悉除滅， 成就一切願求。 設復有人若能每日誦此神呪一百八遍， 即得自身及一切眷屬擁護。
column2: If, moreover, someone is able to chant this spirit-spell 108 times each day, then forthwith, they and all their kin will obtain our protection.

column1: 若能誦五百遍， 大威神力， 五百由旬內普皆圍繞， 一切魔王及諸魔眾、一切障者無量惡鬼不敢親近， 常當擁護。
column2: If, moreover, a person is able to chant it five hundred times [each day], then, because of its awesome spiritual power, within a radius of five hundred yojanas, none of the Māra-kings, demon hordes, obstructers, or the numberless evil ghosts will dare to approach, and we will always protect them.

column1: 北斗八女、一切日月星宿諸、天龍藥叉能作障難者一時斷壞。
column2: The Eight Ladies of the Northern Dipper, the sun, moon, stars, and lodges, all the divine dragons (nāgas), dryads (yakṣas), and those able to create obstructions and difficulties will at once cease their obstruction.

column1: 若人欲供養者， 先發拔濟心， 於清淨寂靜之處， 以香華飲食供養，
column2: If someone wishes to worship them, first arouse an altruistic mind and, in a pure place suitable for meditation, take incense, flowers, drink, and food for offerings.

column1: 持念神呪結印契。
column2: Recite the spirit-spell and make the mudrā.

column1: 如是供養時， 八女及一切眷屬現身， 隨意奉仕， 成就無量願求。
column2: If you make offerings thus, the Eight Ladies and their retinue will manifest, and in accord with one’s wishes, they will serve you, and you will accomplish your limitless desires.

column1: 惹位即得， 何況世間少少官位榮耀。
column2: If it is kingly status you desire, you will have it—how much more so the status and glory of lesser worldly positions?

column1: 若求壽命， 削定業籍， 還付生籍。
column2: If you want long life, they will scratch out your karmic register and restore your life register.

column1: 若諸國王王子大臣後宮等， 於自宮中作曼荼羅， 如法護摩禮拜供養， 北斗八女皆大歡喜，
column2: If all the kings of states, the princes, the great officers, those of the rear courts, and so on, construct maṇḍalas in their palaces and pay obeisance in accordance with the appropriate homa, the Eight Ladies of the Northern Dipper will be delighted.

column1: 故久居勝位恒常受安樂，
column2: As a result, you will long abide in a superior position and constantly be happy.

column1: 百官上下和穆不行非法，
column2: The one hundred officers—those superior and those inferior—will be in harmony and not commit acts contrary to the teaching.

column1: 人民熾盛、稼穡豐饒、國土安寧，
column2: The people will flourish, and the harvests will be abundant.

column1: 無有災難、不現異怪、疫病死亡不起， 境內怨敵群賊自然退散。
column2: The state will be at peace without disasters, and strange occurrences will not manifest. Sickness and death will not arise, and all the criminals within the borders will naturally disperse.

column1: 」故以是法甚為祕密， 不信者及無智人中勿妄宣傳。
column2: Therefore, keep this method secret from unbelievers and do not transmit it to the ignorant.

column1: 無智人不分明心故，
column2: This is because those who are ignorant have minds that do not discriminate.

column1: 不得法意生疑謗。
column2: Being unable to grasp the intent of the teaching, they give rise to doubt and criticism.

column1: 雖無智人金剛生金剛子等， 常誦持佛眼母明者當宣傳。
column2: Although ignorant, those born of the Vajra [‘Diamond’], sons of the Vajra, and the like constantly chant and maintain the Buddha-Eye-Mother mantra, and this teaching ought to be transmitted to them.

column1: 金剛子雖無智， 不生疑謗， 故成就法。
column2: Though ignorant, the Vajra-sons do not doubt or criticize and therefore attain success with the method.

column1: 行者雖樂世間樂， 深迴向無上正等菩提。
column2: As for those who practice it, even in the joy of Sukhāvatī, they profoundly reorient themselves toward attaining unsurpassed bodhi [enlightenment].
